content: If the RoeEvent was setup with the StorageState set to 'storeEvent' and no StartResponseOnEvent with StorageState set to 'storeEvent' and an EventWindowTime which is active over power cycles or clearResponseOnEvent has been received afterwards the Dcm will change to 'ROE stopped' state as soon as the non-volatile information is available.
